steps.content: After the Crypt Operation, Bureau Office

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is the Ring Research Institute still unable to provide the MBCC with relevant information about the Mania Crystal?
My apologies. Currently, no one in the Ring Research Institute can answer your questions.
At the forefront of the DisCity's academia, the Ring Research Institute is the synonym of omniscience.
If even the Ring Research Institute cannot explain it, you can't imagine just what kind of rare object that red crystal could be.
That being said, in that cage of yours... there's one person who must know the answers.
In the absence of an interesting invention or an unexplored theory, you won't be able to pique her interest to answer your questions.
He opens the cabinet and takes out an object that looks like a Rubik's cube. You examine its inside carefully and find something in there.

options: What is this?

choices.text: What is this?

steps.content: Take this as an apology gift from the Ring Research Institute for failing to answer your questions directly.
Bring this with you, and she'll surely give you a satisfying answer.
Time's up. I'll see you next time, the Chief of the MBCC.
The communication is cut off. At the same time, the Bureau receives a mysterious object from the Ring Research Institute in the mailbox.
In the interrogation room, Summer keeps fiddling with the Rubik's cube in her hands without lifting her gaze once.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Hmm?
She narrows her eyes and glances at the incandescent lamp on the ceiling, then at you who's turned on the light, and finally shifts her attention back to her own hands.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Hmm... Looks like this time I can solve it completely within ten seconds. After all, a quiet environment is the best.
The young girl before you is twisting the Rubik's cube rapidly while mumbling something constantly, treating you like a mere strand of smoke that's flown into the room.

options: Can we start already?
Can you stop playing with that for a moment?

choices.text: Can we start already?
Can you stop playing with that for a moment?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Oh... Oh, whenever you're ready.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Let's get it over with quickly.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Hmm... Sure.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I'll solve this side in a second... Yep, hold on.
She goes along with what you're saying and keeps twisting the 11x11 Rubik's cube unthinkingly.
In mere seconds, squares of different colors are returned to their original positions.
Of course, she's the prodigy who kept skipping grades and got into the Ring Research Institute at 14. The common 3x3 Rubik's cube must be a piece of cake to her.
You flip through Summer's research theses, wanting to spot some things you can ask her about.

A Brief Introduction to the Faults in the Crystallized Ring Substance Rechargeable Battery's Design and Their Solutions, Simulated Calculation Theory of the Ring Substance's Waste Heat Emission, A Study on the Ring Substance's Second Order Entropy Change Calculation...
Every word and every study is accompanied by danger and the unknown.
The research materials she uses are all the most unstable Ring substance closest to its original state. A single mistake could have obliterated the entire Ring Research Institute.

Yet Summer had been tampering with this incredibly dangerous stuff for three years. No wonder some say that instead of calling her the genius of the Research Institute, titles like mad scientist or explorer of the forbidden suit her more.

Are you familiar with this?
Summer takes one single glance at the weapon reflecting an ominous glint and answers you immediately.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Of course. This is the improved version of the mass-produced light Mania weapon II. Average power. It can't even make a hole in that door in front of you.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: That's all. Can I go now?
Summer impatiently tries to stand up from the chair, as if she has some urgent matter to attend to. But your questioning has only just begun.

options: What about that thing on top of it?

choices.text: What about that thing on top of it?

steps.content: You point at the dip on the weapon. There was a crystal on it, but you removed it beforehand for safety reasons.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: ...I'm not sure what kind of obsession you have over that filthy thing.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: But if you just want to know its parameters, it's best you ask the guys at the Ring Research Institute.
They have no idea.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: It's been so long, and they still haven't figured out anything?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Sigh... Their productivity is disappointing as always.

options: Can you tell me about this crystal?

choices.text: Can you tell me about this crystal?

steps.content: I see that it's been discussed in many of your theses.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: No.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Because I'm only a student now. A student... can't know anything about such an advanced subject.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I believe what you should give this student now is a little bit of freedom.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Right, Chief?
This is no regular interrogation in which things are under your control. This science master before you is obviously only concerned about how to get out of here, and you can't do anything about it.
She doesn't want to go deep into your questions, so she's only brushing them off with unimportant information.
<color=#fb9259>"You need something to pique her interest."</color>
<color=#fb9259>"It has to be either a great invention she's never seen before, or this."</color>
The man's words ring in your head.
It looks like you'll need to count on Summer's former employer, after all.

options: I'll pay a consultation fee.

choices.text: I'll pay a consultation fee.

steps.content: Summer doesn't respond directly this time, but you notice that she's definitely looking more interested.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: DisCoins? I don't need them. Not interested.

options: Not money. An item.

choices.text: Not money. An item.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Let me put it out there, I'm not interested in ordinary items.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Don't waste your time if it's not some highly classified research material or report.

Before Summer finishes, you put on a pair of gloves and uncover the hidden layer in the evidence cabinet.
A pale blue light starts to glow in the room.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: These are...?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Die! Die! Die!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: That thing... I know what I saw! It must be that!
After seeing the object in the evidence cabinet, indifference has completely vanished from Summer. She stows away the Rubik's cube, her face brimming with excitement.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Ahem! Mr. Chief.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Well... Conflicting points of view are inevitable during academic exchanges.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Could you hand that object to me directly? I, Summer, promise to brand your name onto my next great invention!

options: Can you crack its encryption?

choices.text: Can you crack its encryption?

steps.content: Last week, the MBCC hired several dozen hackers and they worked for around 100 hours in vain to crack the encryption on it.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Hey, don't you underestimate me!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: As long as you hand that thing to me... I'll answer whatever questions you have! Mania Crystals, the Black Ring, anything!

options: Do we have a deal?

choices.text: Do we have a deal?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Yes!
Summer presses down on several squares of the Rubik's cube and it expands instantly, ripping open all the outer material and wrapping tightly around that videotape.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Let me see... what's become of the thing inside...
Frankly, you're a bit nervous.
The thing that piques the interest of the former top genius of the Ring Research Institute is probably about to be revealed before your eyes.

options: Are you sure it's appropriate that I see this?
What on earth is inside it?

choices.text: Are you sure it's appropriate that I see this?
What on earth is inside it?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Of course it is. Why not?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: How unexciting it will be to have no one to share this kind of great masterpiece with.
You're surprised to see this noble side of Summer's. As a scientist, she seems completely unbothered by someone peeking at her important research outcome.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: My biggest, most important masterpiece, of course!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: But it'll be too unexciting to have no one to share this kind of great masterpiece with.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I'll give you special permission to view it with me this time!
As the layers of outer material keep peeling off, you can't help getting nervous.
The walls of the interrogation room are covered by pitch-black projections. The incomparable masterpiece of the genius is about to be presented before you.
The world is once again on the verge of destruction. A mysterious disaster has brought tragedies to tens of millions.
Summer has been robbed of her health and become sickly and bedridden. She can only waste her days away watching anime.
However, she meets a high school girl who drives a giant robot to save the world, and Summer finally finds her dream.
"I want to become an invincible high school girl too. I want to solve the mystery and save the world!"
She becomes a motivated little genius.
The most renowned genius inventor in the city.
...The youngest chief scientist of the top research institute.
...The girl who was robbed of hope by the disaster has now overcome the challenges and is back to face the disaster head-on.
This time, she's set to challenge the mystery and save humanity.
To be continued...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Hey, so, how was it? It's pretty awesome, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Humph, those guys at the Ring Research Institute have done a pretty good job. They've finally come to this point after all these years!
There's no incomparable masterpiece or groundbreaking discovery. This is only a super cheap and cheesy anime storyboard.
You can't connect the young girl before you to the researcher of a forbidden substance.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Hahaha... Still brings back memories no matter how many times I've watched it.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: This theatrical version consists of three episodes. It tells the story of a genius teenage girl named Summer who becomes an invincible high schooler and ends up saving the world.

options: The protagonist of the story...

choices.text: The protagonist of the story...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is this Summer girl based on yourself?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Spot on! My dream is to realize this exhilarating and motivational story so it can be passed on for generations!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: She was born a sickly child but her intelligence is beyond measure. She skips grades and enters high school, then she gets into the top research institute, absolutely kills it, and gets acclaimed as the savior of the world.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Isn't that super exhilarating? Chief!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Ahem... Production aside, what do you think about the script?
Rather than a fantasy, it's more like a middle schooler's daydream.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: What's that silence supposed to mean.
I just think everyone's passion deserves to be respected.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Humph... Chief! Don't you watch anime at all? You'll age quickly like that!

options: I've just watched Frameman the Slow Agent.
I've just watched The Madnug: Black Water Orphans.

choices.text: I've just watched Frameman the Slow Agent.
I've just watched The Madnug: Black Water Orphans.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Oh! That one... I've been watching it too lately!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: High school girls and giant robots... make the perfect match, don't they!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Oh...? It looks like you're a trend follower when it comes to anime, Chief...
Why?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Because there are too many epic scenes in that one. You see them everywhere on the internet and the show's gotten a lot of attention.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Damn it, but that ending was so poorly made... I refuse to recognize it as part of the Madnug series!
Summer is getting more and more excited as she speaks. It seems that she hasn't chatted about anime with someone face-to-face in a long time.
Although you'd like to chat more with her, you have a more important task at hand.

options: You should answer my questions now.

choices.text: You should answer my questions now.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You've promised.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Ahem, of course. I, Summer, am destined to become a hero, I'll always keep my promises!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Seeing that you could obtain a Mania weapon like that, you must have been in contact with Black Water for quite a bit, which means... you shouldn't be completely ignorant about that thing.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: But as a thank-you for bringing me that videotape, I won't probe further.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Do you want a detailed explanation, or just a general one?

options: A detailed one.
Keep it general.

choices.text: A detailed one.
Keep it general.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Oh, an unlikely scholar.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: It's a shame that... we don't have enough space here.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Not enough space?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Hmm... Let me see. I'll need a blackboard—at least this big.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What are you gonna do?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Draw its crystal structure, of course.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...No need to go that in-depth.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I only need to know the relations among Mania Crystals, Black Rings, and Sinners.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: How general? Do you need to know its reactivity? Polarity? Bioactivity? Phases? Or something else?
Listening to Summer talk, you somehow feel dizzy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: None of the above. I only need to know the relations among Mania Crystals, Black Rings, and Sinners.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Hmm... Alright. Let me think of... how to present it more visually for you.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I know! Let's use this!
Summer grabs the iced water on the table.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: You have that weapon with you, that means you've been to that crypt, right? Let's assume that crypt is this glass containing water.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: If the temperature continues to drop, you get more and more ice in the glass. Similarly... if the contamination level rises in the crypt, you get more and more Ring substance in it.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The Mania Crystal is not exactly a common crystal. It's a crystal formed after the Ring substance has absorbed a Sinner's spiritual energy.

options: And how does the Mania Crystal affect Sinners?

choices.text: And how does the Mania Crystal affect Sinners?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: You should know that... Mania is in essence a form of mental breakdown.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The invisible and intangible spiritual energy is projected into our real world and becomes a substance.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: That can be said for those spikes, the contamination, and the mutation.

options: Just like what I saw in the crypt?

choices.text: Just like what I saw in the crypt?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Yes. The Ring substance is a special kind of contamination.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: It's different from the usual mental contamination with a strong manic will... I still haven't found out from whom the Ring substance comes from.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: On the contrary, it's like a blank catalyst which only amplifies and catalyzes others' wills.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Therefore, under certain conditions, the Ring substance will resonate with a Sinner's manic spirit. Just like a photocopier. It becomes a physical manic conscious being.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The so-called Mania Crystals are spirit crystals created through duplicating Sinners' emotional fluctuations. And they're a kind of portable mental power generator.

options: Then the Laboratory of Parma...

choices.text: Then the Laboratory of Parma...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've seen many of these things there.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: That's right. I'm afraid that facility obtains the Sinners' abilities they favor through experiments that stimulate Sinners' minds and force them to stay in a manic state for extended periods to lengthen the time of resonance.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I've looked on the dark web. That one named Ninety-Nine is probably one of the top-selling Fury fighters in Syndicate.
She's right. Syndicate worships power, and Ninety-Nine is the synonym of extreme power. It's only a matter of time before she becomes a hot pick.
You recall the way Ninety-Nine looked when she was injured. Tremendous pain must lie beneath that powerful surface.
But... how did Parma get the technology? The conditions in Syndicate are extremely harsh and the refinement of Mania Crystals is utterly difficult.
Yet Mania weapons began flourishing rapidly in Syndicate at a particular point in time. That is virtually impossible without help from the outside.
Mania Crystals evolve from the Ring substance, and Summer is closely related to them.

options: How are Mania weapons different from your weapon?

choices.text: How are Mania weapons different from your weapon?

steps.content: You shift your gaze to the drones sitting in the corner.
Their appearances and propelling mechanisms are... very similar, coincidentally.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: They're not the same thing at all! Don't compare my unique invention to those mass-produced defective products, Chief!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Humph... These copycats are even copying my design, how dare they...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: They don't even understand the second law of the Ring substance at all, the research I've put my blood, sweat, and tears into, and they've created this kind of garbage...
Summer looks like she's getting in the mood to continue talking about the Ring substance, so you quickly switch the topic.

options: I have another thing to show you.

choices.text: I have another thing to show you.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Oh? What is it? Is it the second episode of the theatrical version? I remember they only drew a rough draft at that time...
You shake your head and pass a document to Summer.

steps.content: Are you taking me out on an operation, Chief? Ah... No, not today, I only have the strength left for walking back to my room.

Do you know about this incident?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Ahem, what a shame! This is the end of Miss Summer's Q&A session!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: It's already 7:58. My favorite show, Maken Radar, is about to start. You said you'd let me go on time before I came.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The Q&A session is over. For your next consultation, remember to bring the second episode!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Oh, by the way, you're welcome anytime to discuss anime with me!
It looks like this genius's weird temper has cropped up again.
You sigh and open the interrogation room's door.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Tokusatsu show, here I come!
With the help of the drones, Summer dashes out of the interrogation room.
